Definition: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
BiblicalUsage: subst; 1) a going round, continuance; adv; 2) still, yet, again, besides; 2a) still, yet (of continuance or persistence); 2b) still, yet, more (of addition or repetition); 2c) again; 2d) still, moreover, besides
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
